paths.description: Homepage and first-visit consent entry state, representing the main news discovery journey.
Football section/listing template, representing high-density section navigation and card grids.
News article/detail template, representing the core content-reading journey and rich metadata.
Scores and fixtures surface, representing dynamic sports data and mobile use.
Get Sky entry page, representing the public commercial conversion journey before account/payment steps.
Unknown route, representing HTTP error handling and recovery.

findings.summary: The site does not adapt its visual theme to the user’s dark-mode preference.
findings.evidence: Paired 1440x900 screenshots under normal and prefers-color-scheme: dark are pixel-identical (both 544,208 bytes), and captured CSS contains no prefers-color-scheme rule.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide preference-driven surface, text, control and media colors using prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: Route changes do not use View Transitions.
findings.evidence: The captured CSS contains no view-transition declarations and the live DOM probe found no view-transition styling across this multi-page news experience.
findings.suggestedFix: Use cross-document View Transitions for eligible same-origin navigation, with a no-motion fallback.

findings.summary: Persistent navigation does not expose declarative scroll-state-aware behaviour.
findings.evidence: Captured CSS contains no scroll-state query or scroll timeline, while desktop screenshots show a large, persistent two-level navigation area.
findings.suggestedFix: Use scroll-state container queries for sticky header state and retain a static fallback.

findings.summary: The first-visit cookie wall obscures the primary content on every sampled public route.
findings.evidence: Desktop screenshots show a modal covering roughly the lower third of the viewport with the page dimmed; at 360x800 it covers most of the viewport before any user action.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce the initial consent surface to the minimum legally required, preserve an equally prominent essential-only choice, and ensure content remains readable where policy permits.

findings.summary: The consent flow uses a custom role=dialog container rather than the native dialog primitive.
findings.evidence: The recon probe identifies DIV role=dialog, not an open dialog element, for the modal consent surface.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a native dialog with modal focus management, labelled title/description and deliberate consent dismissal controls.

findings.summary: The mobile consent layout clips both edge actions and blocks core news, scores and commercial journeys.
findings.evidence: At 360x800, “Essential cookies only” is clipped off the left edge and “Accept all” is clipped off the right edge on homepage, scores and Get Sky captures; most underlying content is unavailable.
findings.suggestedFix: Reflow consent actions into a full-width vertical or wrapping group with safe inline padding, then test at 320–400 CSS px and 200% zoom.

findings.summary: A meaningful set of interactive targets is too small for robust touch use.
findings.evidence: The homepage probe found 48 visible anchors/buttons/inputs with either width or height below 24 CSS px; the sampled first focus target does have a visible browser outline.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase compact targets and their hit areas toward at least 44×44 CSS px without crowding adjacent actions, while retaining visible focus.

findings.summary: Throttled mobile loading misses the Core Web Vitals LCP bar.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 7.4s, Speed Index 4.6s and Time to Interactive 8.0s (performance score 0.60), although an unthrottled trace measured LCP 1.65s and only 20.74ms TBT.
findings.suggestedFix: Profile the LCP element and prioritize its discovery/delivery; delay non-critical consent, analytics and below-fold work.

findings.summary: Images lack intrinsic dimensions and the throttled run records material layout shift.
findings.evidence: The images primitive found width/height attributes missing on all 100 sampled homepage images and all 100 sampled article images; Lighthouse measured CLS 0.181.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit width and height or a stable aspect-ratio for every image/card slot before loading content.

findings.summary: Substantial unused CSS/JavaScript and third-party code inflate delivery.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 119 KiB unused JavaScript and 90 KiB unused CSS. The HAR records 19 scripts (367,619 transferred bytes), 10 fonts (221,893 bytes), and 218,143 third-party bytes.
findings.suggestedFix: Split template CSS/JS, load live components conditionally, prune duplicate bundles and defer analytics code until it is needed and permitted.

findings.summary: Some homepage links have no accessible name and heading levels skip structure.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found three pundit headline links in the tab order with no accessible text and reported invalid H4/H3 heading order; accessibility score was 0.95.
findings.suggestedFix: Give each card link a programmatic name from its visible headline and make card headings follow the page section hierarchy.

findings.summary: The homepage logs uncaught runtime errors.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse recorded ReferenceError: _satellite is not defined and a TypeError in ui-sitewide-dynamic-tile during load.
findings.suggestedFix: Guard optional analytics dependencies, correct dynamic-tile initialization ordering and add production error monitoring regression coverage.

findings.summary: The homepage omits a canonical URL and the scores title is not present in raw HTML.
findings.evidence: The homepage metadata probe returned no canonical link. Discoverability found the scores page content fully server-rendered but titlePresentInRaw=false.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit stable canonical links on every indexable template and ensure the final descriptive title is present in the initial server HTML.

findings.summary: Two first-party cookies are set without Secure and all six sampled cookies use SameSite=None.
findings.evidence: The cookie audit shows bm_lso and ak_bmsc with secure=false; six of six cookies use SameSite=None, including several that do not need cross-site semantics.
findings.suggestedFix: Set Secure on every production cookie and choose Lax/Strict unless a documented cross-site flow requires None; review HttpOnly where script access is unnecessary.

findings.summary: Third-party measurement code loads before a consent decision and consumes a material share of the initial transfer.
findings.evidence: The pre-consent HAR records 18 third-party requests and 218,143 transferred bytes, including Covatic and Dotmetrics; trackers enumeration finds eight third-party origins.
findings.suggestedFix: Gate non-essential measurement behind consent, reduce vendors, batch permitted analytics and enforce a third-party byte/request budget.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced policy coverage is incomplete and the CSP only defines frame ancestors.
findings.evidence: Headers include HSTS and nosniff, but omit Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy. CSP contains only frame-ancestors and therefore does not constrain script/style/connect sources.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a nonce/hash-based CSP with explicit source directives, plus a strict Referrer-Policy and least-privilege Permissions-Policy.

findings.summary: Fixture times do not expose a time-zone context for users outside the UK.
findings.evidence: The scores probe lists semantic time values such as text “5.00pm” with datetime “17:00”, but no zone or offset is present in the sampled output.
findings.suggestedFix: State the schedule time zone and offer locale/time-zone-aware display while retaining machine-readable unambiguous datetimes.

findings.summary: Image delivery relies overwhelmingly on legacy formats and incomplete responsive source selection.
findings.evidence: The homepage image audit reports 92 legacy-format images, only 2 modern-format images and 45 missing srcset among 100 sampled images; the article sample reports 99 legacy formats.
findings.suggestedFix: Negotiate AVIF/WebP where appropriate and provide width-aware srcset/sizes while preserving optimized fallbacks.

taskList.title: Make the consent experience responsive and content-preserving
Fix insecure cookie attributes and strengthen browser policies
Improve LCP and eliminate layout shifts
Restore accessible names, heading order and touch target sizing
Gate and reduce third-party work and unused bundles
Add time-zone context to fixture times
Adopt declarative navigation transitions and scroll state
